newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shares end higher led by benchmark Telefonica.
newsitem.headline: Lima shares end higher led by benchmark Telefonica.

text.p: Shares on the Lima Stock Exchange closed higher for the fourth consecutive session on Tuesday led by Telefonica del Peru, brokers said.
Benchmark Telefonica del Peru closed 0.93 percent higher at 6.49 soles with 2.3 million shares changing hands.
The market is likely to continue climbing Wednesday but traders expected technical corrections in some stocks, they added.
Tuesday, the General Index rose 0.55 percent to 1,716.15 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index climbed 0.73 percent to 2,485.32 points.
In a total of 1,921 trades, volume was a 38.6 million soles ($14.6 million), according to preliminary figures.

The market has registered strong gains since Friday's announcement of the latest Gross Domestic Product figure. The economy grew 4.1 percent year-on-year in February compared with 4.2 percent growth in the year to February 1996.
"Internal (econonomic) factors are good and companies are going to record good results," Julio Alcalde of local brokerage MGS said.
Miner Morococha continued its bull run, climbing 4.42 percent to 2.60 soles on volume of 498,000 shares.
Polymetal miner Buenaventura remained stable at 24.30 soles on volume of 23,500 shares.
